title: BodyParts3D 4.0: the whole body of an adult man as 2,234 polygon meshes of its parts, each the representation of a concept of the Foundational Model of Anatomy, with FMA's is-a and part-of trees over them and the parts that compose each compound concept
provider: The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), Research Organization of Information and Systems, Japan: N. Mitsuhashi, K. Fujieda, T. Tamura, S. Kawamoto, T. Takagi and K. Okubo; release 4.0 of 2013-05-16, archived 2013-06-19
credit: Anatomy: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY 4.0
format: A zip of 2,234 Wavefront OBJ files (FJnnnn.obj; FJnnnnM a part mirrored to the other side), each one element: vertices (v), vertex normals (vn) and triangles (f v//vn), with a header naming the FMA concept, its English name, its bounds in mm and its volume in cm³ as the database computed it. Coordinates in millimetres in the database's frame, which is the LPS patient frame of DICOM: +x the subject's left, +y posterior, +z superior, the body's midline near x = 0, the soles near z = 0 and every part at z > 0. Tab-separated tables: the concepts of each tree (FMA id, representation id, English name); the inclusion relations (parent id and name, child id and name), each a tree; and the elements that compose each compound concept (concept id, name, element file id). The meshes are those of the is-a tree, which holds every element; the part-of tree's 1,258 elements are among them.
coverage: The whole body of one adult man in the anatomical position: skin and hair; the skeleton with its cartilages, ligaments and joints; 432 muscles and their parts; the heart with its valves and cavities; 639 arteries and 395 veins of the systemic, pulmonary and portal circulations; the brain, spinal cord and nerves; the eyes; the respiratory, digestive, urinary, genital, endocrine and lymphoid organs. Not the female body; no lymph nodes or lymphatic vessels; the liver and lungs as segments with their vessels rather than as whole organs.
licence: CC BY 4.0 since 2025-02-25 (README_e.html §3 of the database, updated that day); the files' own headers still carry the earlier notice, CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan. Attribute as "BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International".
